$comment: P127 B3 cross-runtime interfaces parity fixture: interface member model, dispatch, statics, generic statics and property accessor forms. Each case calls a static Probe function of `source` on a fresh session; `returns` pins its result and `refuses` the error it throws. Expected values match .NET 10 except where the spec pins NeoScript spelling. The web half runs through `neo test` (cli/src/commands/p127-interfaces-parity.test.ts); the Unity half runs the same cases over a `neo export`. Vendor this file verbatim.
source: interface IDescribed<T> { string Describe() => typeof(T).Name; }
class Money : IDescribed<int>, IDescribed<string> { string IDescribed<string>.Describe() => "money"; }
interface J { sealed int M() => 2; private int H() => 7; int Call() => H(); }
class JC : J { public int M() => 3; public int H() => 9; }
interface IWho { string Who() => "base"; }
interface IMid : IWho { string IWho.Who() => "mid"; }
class MidC : IMid { }
class WhoC : IWho { public string Who() => "class"; }
class B1 : IWho { public virtual string Who() => "b1"; }
class D1 : B1 { public override string Who() => "d1"; }
class B3 : IWho { string IWho.Who() => "b3-explicit"; public string Who() => "b3"; }
class D3 : B3 { }

class KD<T> : K<string> { }
interface IPair<A, B> { string Second() => typeof(B).Name; }
class Pairs<T> : IPair<T, List<T>> { }
class Animal { public virtual string Sound() => "..."; }
class Cat : Animal { public override string Sound() => "meow"; }
interface IOut<out T> { T Get(); }
interface IIn<in T> { string Take(T value); }
class CatBox : IOut<Cat> { public Cat Get() => new Cat(); }
class IntBox : IOut<int> { public int Get() => 1; }
class AnyTaker : IIn<Animal> { public string Take(Animal value) => value.Sound(); }
interface IRank<T> { int Rank(T other); }
interface INamed { string Name(); }
class Score : Animal, IRank<Score>, INamed {
public int Value = 0;
public int Rank(Score other) => this.Value - other.Value;
public string Name() => "score";
interface IZero { static abstract int Zero { get; } static virtual int One() => 1; static int Two() => 2; }
class Naught : IZero { public static int Zero => 3; }
interface IMake<T extends IMake<T>> { static abstract T Make(int seed); static abstract int Count { get; set; } static virtual string Tag() => "default"; }

class Coin : IMake<Coin> { public int Value; private static int tally = 0; public static Coin Make(int seed) => new Coin() { Value = seed * 2 }; public static int Count { get => tally; set => tally = value; } }

class Gem : IMake<Gem> { public int Value; private static int tally = 0; static Gem IMake<Gem>.Make(int seed) => new Gem() { Value = seed + 100 }; public static int Count { get => tally; set => tally = value; } public static string Tag() => "gem"; }

class StaticBox<T> { public static int Count = 0; public static T Held = default(T); public static List<T> Items = []; public static string Name() => typeof(T).Name; public static void Bump() { Count = Count + 1; } }
class IntStaticBox : StaticBox<int> { public void Add() { Count = Count + 1; } }
class ListBox<U> : StaticBox<List<U>> { public static string Inner() => Name(); }
class Order<T> { public static int A = B + 1; public static int B = A + 1; }
class Bad<T> { public static int X = Boom(); public static int Boom() { throw new NeoInvalidOperationError(message: "no"); } }
interface ICounter<T> { static int Count = 0; static void Bump() { Count = Count + 1; } static string Name() => typeof(T).Name; }
class NBox<T> { public static int Count = 0; }

class AutoBase { public int W { get; protected set; } = 1; public int R { get; } = 2; public AutoBase() { R = 3; W = 4; } public static int Count { get; private set; } = 0; public static void Bump() => Count++; }
class AutoDerived : AutoBase { public AutoDerived() { W = 5; } }
class SetOnlyShop { public int Seen = 0; public int W { set { Seen = value * 2; } } public List<int> Values = [1, 2, 3]; public int Trigger { set { Seen = Values[0]; } } }
class InitIds { public static int Counter = 0; public static int Next() { Counter = Counter + 1; return Counter; } }
class InitCounted { public int Id = InitIds.Next(); public int Seen = 0; }
class InitLast { public static InitLast? Latest = null; public int X = 0; public int Y = 0; public static InitLast Make() { var l = new InitLast(); Latest = l; return l; } }
class InitOnly { public int A { get; init; } = 0; public int B { get => 0; init { A = value; } } }
class InitOnlyDerived : InitOnly { public InitOnlyDerived() { A = 9; } }
class GetterBase { int stored = 0; public virtual int V { get => stored; protected set { stored = value; } } public void SetV(int x) { V = x; } }
class GetterDerived : GetterBase { public override int V { get => base.V * 10; } }
class AutoGetterBase { public virtual int V { get; protected set; } = 9; public void SetV(int x) { V = x; } }
class AutoGetterDerived : AutoGetterBase { public override int V { get => base.V * 10; } public void Bump() { V = V + 1; } }
class AutoSetterDerived : AutoGetterBase { public override int V { protected set => base.V = value * 2; } }
class AutoOverride : AutoGetterBase { public override int V { get; protected set; } = 4; }
class AutoOverrideGetter : AutoOverride { public override int V { get => base.V + 100; } }
class SetterBase { public virtual int G1 { get => 1; set { Stored = value; } } public int Stored = 0; }
class SetterDerived : SetterBase { public override int G1 { set { Stored = value + 100; } } }
interface IPut { static int P { get; private set; } = 1; static void Put(int v) { P = v; } int Q { get => 1; private set { } } }
class PutC : IPut { public int Q => 2; }
interface JT { static int Log = 0; int T { get => 1; private set { Log = value; } } void Go() { T = 5; } }
class C4 : JT { public int Stored = 0; public int T { get => 3; set { Stored = value; } } }
interface KW { static int Seen = 0; int W { get => 0; protected set { Seen = value; } } }
interface KW2 : KW { void Set() { W = 9; } }
class KWC : KW2 { }
interface IRo { int P { get => 1; private set { } } }
class RoC : IRo { public readonly int P = 42; }

class MBox<T> { public static int Count = 0; public static int Make() { Count = Count + 1; return Count; } public static string Name() => typeof(T).Name; public static NeoDelegate<string> Namer() => () => typeof(T).Name; public static NeoDelegate<string> Group() => Name; }
class MD : MBox<int> { }
interface IG { int M(); int Twice() { NeoDelegate<int> f = M; return f() + f(); } }
class GC : IG { public int M() => 4; }
interface IGen<T> { string Name() => typeof(T).Name; NeoDelegate<string> Get() { NeoDelegate<string> f = Name; return f; } }
class GG : IGen<int> { }
interface IDef { static int Log = 0; int P { get => 1; set { Log = value; } } }
class DefC : IDef { public int P => 7; }
interface IGetDef { int Q { get => 5; set { } } }
class GetDefC : IGetDef { public int Stored = 0; public int Q { set { Stored = value; } } }
class PA { public int Log = 0; public virtual int V { get => 1; private set { Log = value; } } public int Put(int x) { V = x; return Log * 10 + V; } }
class PB : PA { public override int V => 2; }
class Bag<T>(T item) { public T Item = item; }
class Gen { public static Bag<List<T>> G<T>(T x) => new Bag<List<T>>([x]); public static bool Wrap<T>(T x, int n) => n == 0 ? x is List<List<List<int>>> : Wrap<List<T>>([x], n - 1); }
class Probe {

public static int StaticAbstractProperty() => Probe.ZeroOf<Naught>();
public static int OneOf<T extends IZero>() => T.One();
public static int StaticVirtualDefault() => Probe.OneOf<Naught>();

public static int StaticAbstractExplicit() => Probe.Create<Gem>(5).Value;
